post.description:
Exécute le batch de récupération des résultats MyCompet FFME pour les compétitions passées
et envoie un e-mail de synthèse si des résultats sont découverts.
Called by Cloud Scheduler every day at 07:00 (its OIDC token, see api_auth.SCHEDULER_PATHS) or by an admin.
`force` (every competition ended in the last year, results or not) and `email` (another recipient): admin only.
503: the competitions could not be read, nothing was done (Cloud Scheduler shows the run as failed).

get.description: Directory of the members (read only, readable offline): Vue application, on phones as on desktop.
Point d'entrée racine : les compétitions (application Vue).

Competitions (readable offline, changed offline through the outbox) and the Google sign-in callback (the OAuth
redirect URI registered for the club): Vue application, on phones as on desktop. Also the PWA's start page.
Manifeste PWA pour installation sur smartphone.

Service worker of the Vue application (frontend/src/sw.ts, hashed precache), built into frontend/dist. Served
from / for its scope to cover every page; same address as the former hand-written worker, which it replaces in
the browsers that have it. Checked again on every visit (no-cache).

Version deployed (code_source/VERSION, APP_VERSION): the app compares it with its own to offer an update. Never
cached by the service worker.
Vérification de santé (Cloud Run probes, uptime, monitoring).
